sql: SELECT p.strategy, to_char(p.closed_at,'YYYY-MM') AS mon, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN p.pnl<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses, round((100.0*sum(p.pnl)/nullif(sum(p.quantity),0))::numeric,2) AS c_per_ct, round(avg(p.assumed_price)::numeric,1) AS px FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE '%MENTION%' AND p.status <> 'open' AND p.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.strategy IN ('mmsell','mmsell10','mmsell6','mmsell1','mmsell2','mmsell3') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
